title: How a dance set is structured
summary: Sets, waltz every fourth set, hours, seasonal slumps and the list of tunes.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Oh, it was fun. It was a good band. Good women's section, good arms. You read arrangements too, I don't know. You read and you play by ear too?

Yeah, we were starting, we were jamming. They had the waltzes in between. That's what we were doing on the other side. It was the same thing. You see, about every fourth set we hit a waltz. We can like a medley. If we have no requests, well, we just play medleys maybe, anything we feel like. We had to play it in a long time, we play in the form of a medley.
And you play, would you play a slow one and a fast one, a waltz, a slow one and a fast one? How would that work?

We just, we see a slow one and a fast one. Or a slow and a medium one. And say about the fourth set is a waltz and that's a fast one. And then the couple, you know, most sets than that is intermission. And we go back to the oil route and the slow one and the fast one again. And what time do you start? Well, on a Friday from 8.30 to 1.30. On a Saturday from 8.30 to 2.30. And on a Sunday from 8 until 1. We had a pretty nice frowl Sunday but Saturday was a little slack. I mean, you know, cold and the weather just linked in on us and... I mean, they sort of threw some of them. Yeah, well I guess that hurt you. Yeah, and after they get adjusted to it then you'll see them. Does Christmas hurt you? I don't know. Oh. Oh, see just before Christmas it's sort of slow. Like right now it's slowed up some. I have noticed it for last year it's the same way. Yeah. And it's also the same around Easter time and Lent and so forth. It slows down some. And after that, I mean, a lot of folks do take their vacations and all that. Why do you put that limit on your life?
Why do you put that list of tens up there?

Well, just to remind them that we're open for requests and so forth. And then some of the latest numbers. We've got three new ones up there now. I'm not part of the majority of the numbers myself. I don't know anything about buying them. Until you have no more pocket.
